summary: Completed comprehensive testing of UNIFY Smart Campus Platform MVP. Backend APIs are 100% functional with all authentication, role-based access, and core features working perfectly. Frontend UI testing shows excellent functionality with minor navigation issues in mentor dashboard sidebar.

Student dashboard with welcome message and quick access cards
Canteen menu with food images and cart functionality
Events page showing Sci-Tech Fest and Technical Model Competition
Notices page showing Library Timings and Welcome notices
Lost & Found page showing Sunglass and Charger items
Core sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Campus Connect, Chat, Events)
